purpose: Design 17/23 shot intent and real viewer evidence

rows.name: HERO_CLOSE
rows.sourceDescription: Low three-quarter seated chibi on P02 above dark water, face and hands readable.
rows.intent: An intact foreground silhouette with the authentic lotus contact.

projected.method: projected torso centers and runtime botanical frustum, before depth occlusion

rows.name: COMMUNITY_LOW
rows.sourceDescription: Several depth rows of varied chibi, P02 pads, pale blooms and closed buds in dusk.
rows.intent: Foreground, middle and distant figures and real botany around dominant Sakura.

projected.method: projected torso centers and runtime botanical frustum, before depth occlusion

rows.name: SAKURA_AERIAL
rows.sourceDescription: Giant pink canopy above small seated figures, ambient points and layered water.
rows.intent: Aerial scale, pink upper crop and small figures below the tree.

projected.method: projected torso centers and runtime botanical frustum, before depth occlusion

rows.name: GIFT_FOCUS
rows.sourceDescription: Confirmed portrait of the actual giver, warm blessing and readable gift annotation.
rows.intent: Legitimate P05f An with two roses, seed-stable abstract halos, and Duyên text-only.

projected.method: projected torso centers and runtime botanical frustum, before depth occlusion

rows.name: LAKE_REFLECTION
rows.sourceDescription: Low view of dark blue-violet water and warm peach/gold bands, pads and figures.
rows.intent: Peach-gold signal within a dark pond, with flowers and depth layers.

projected.method: projected torso centers and runtime botanical frustum, before depth occlusion

rows.name: GOLD_UNDER_TREE
rows.sourceDescription: Dark Sakura bark with prominent gold fissures and seated figures beneath it.
rows.intent: Visible gold-vein contrast and readable figures below a tall trunk.

projected.method: projected torso centers and runtime botanical frustum, before depth occlusion

rows.name: RETURN_TREE
rows.sourceDescription: Continuous return toward the tree with pink canopy, trunk and lake context.
rows.intent: Native subsequent tree composition after the verified camera return.
